items.label: A WIRELESS CHARGER WITH A POWERFUL DESIGN
items.value: Designed with your style in mind, the Galaxy Magnet Wireless Charger blends into your desk or bedside table perfectly. Thanks to its non-slip surface, your device will always be steady and in place while charging and with its fabric cable, you can forget about tangles.

items.label: BUILT-IN MAGNETS, PERFECTLY ALIGNED
items.value: Precision magnets help perfectly align your device for a more efficient charging experience. Charge your device every time you set it down with the Galaxy Magnet Wireless Charger.
